Berry Burst teammates

Automatic assumes four teammates at this Pokémon’s level, berry type, and favorite bonus. Selected Pokémon use their own stats. Choices are ordered by estimated RP, highest first; unavailable RP appears last. RP above Lv. 70 is unavailable. Empty slots contribute zero.

Island favorites and temporary levels apply to teammates too. This only estimates berries created by the skill; it does not add teammates’ ordinary production. Remembered on this device, separately from Pokémon backups.
